parsed.explanation: The dossier documents state-tolerated targeting plus severe penalties with no working recourse. Nationwide criminalisation (up to 14 years) reaches beyond conduct to association and public presentation, with police torture and arbitrary arrests documented; Sharia death-penalty exposure applies in twelve northern states. Police extortion is explicitly keyed to appearance ('looked gay'), so the sexuality statute operates as a lever against gender-nonconforming people — traveller-facing, not tangential. Mass hotel/party raids show discovery-and-arrest patterns reaching the venues visitors use. A trans woman's killing went unprosecuted with official misgendering; no legal protections exist; app-luring blackmail gangs target outing as leverage. Custody placement is discretionary and unrecorded (an open question, not an exposure). No enacted presentation offence and no universal facility ban keep this above the 0.15 tier, but police predation, impunity and death-penalty exposure place it at the top of High Risk.
